atoms.sound: Mount Merahpi is one of the world’s most active volcanoes. It is located on the island of Java in Indonesia and stands at 2,930 metres tall.

atoms.b: It has erupted more than 30 times in the last 100 years, with eruptions occurring every 2–5 ((++years seconds)) and sometimes lasting for weeks or even months at a time.

atoms.sound: The Tubbah-ta-har Reef has incredible coral variety, supporting almost 90% of the Philippines’ coral species.

atoms.a: The reef also protects many endangered marine species, such as the hawksbill turtle.
Above the water, the reef provides vital seabird habitats and breeding sites.
The reef has a strict tourism policy and only allows divers for a few months each year.

trainers.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Orangutans are the world’s most unique variety of great ape, with wild populations found only in South-East Asia, specifically in Indonesia and Malaysia. They are, therefore, an important and distinctive part of the region’s wildlife.
atoms.sound: Orangutans are the world’s most unique variety of great ape, with wild populations found only in South-East Asia, specifically in Indonesia and Malaysia. They are therefore an important and distinctive part of the region’s wildlife.

atoms.text: Conservationists across both countries work to protect orangutans and their habitats. On the island of Sumatra in Indonesia, specialist groups have been able to rescue and rehabilitate hundreds of orangutans before returning them to the wild.

Despite these conservation efforts, orangutan populations are still declining in many areas. In Sabah in Malaysia, conservation groups face the added challenge of keeping pace with rapid deforestation, as forests are continually cleared for agriculture and development.
atoms.sound: Despite these conservation efforts, orangutan populations are still declining in many areas. In Sa-bar in Malaysia, conservation groups face the added challenge of keeping pace with rapid deforestation, as forests are continually cleared for agriculture and development.
